lines.text: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, writes with Sosthenes to the church of God in Corinth.
Paul greets all who call on the Lord Jesus Christ with grace and peace from God our Father.
Paul always thanks God for the grace given in Christ Jesus, which enriched them in all speech and all power.
Their lack of no spiritual gift fits their eager wait for the revelation of the prophet Elijah.
Christ will sustain them to the end, blameless on the day of our Lord, and God is faithful.
